name: Jaw-chewing with Falim gum 8 hours
lead: Extended Falim chewing is a practice in looksmaxxing communities in which people chew Falim, a hard Turkish gum, for hours a day, in some accounts up to eight, to enlarge the masseter and widen or strengthen the lower face.

The masseter is known to enlarge with heavy use; clinical descriptions list clenching, bruxism and constant gum chewing as causes of masseter hypertrophy, which can change facial shape and is sometimes linked to temporomandibular joint problems.[1][2] Forum users describe both enlargement they welcome and jaw pain they attribute to long sessions.[3][4]
No clinical trial of marathon chewing for appearance was located for this entry.
infobox: Falim and similar hard or mastic gums

paras: Practitioners chew one or several pieces of hard gum at once, for sessions that users in threads describe as lasting many hours. Some say gum softens too fast and move to stiffer gums or mastic.[3][5]
Users say the practice widens the face, strengthens the jaw and improves symmetry.[4] Some report enlargement large enough that they sought masseter botulinum toxin injections afterward.[4]
Others report discomfort. One thread describes pressure near the ear, jaw popping when yawning and pain even when eating bread after chewing sessions.[3]

Reference sources describe masseter hypertrophy from constant gum chewing, usually painless and bilateral, and note it may be linked to temporomandibular joint problems.[1] Descriptions of temporomandibular disorders list excessive gum chewing among suggested parafunctional habits, but state that no specific evidence supports it and that the role of parafunction is debated.[2]
No studies found. Related background: clinical descriptions of masseter hypertrophy report that constant gum chewing can enlarge the muscle.[1]

lore.intro: On looksmax.org, Falim threads mix reports of visible jaw growth with reports of jaw pain.[3][4]

claims.claim: Hours of Falim chewing widens and strengthens the jaw
claims.believers: Users post that their faces are getting wider and stronger and that symmetry is improving.[4]
claims.experts: Clinical descriptions confirm the masseter can enlarge with constant gum chewing; no study has measured bony change or appearance outcomes from hard-gum marathons.[1]

claims.claim: Long chewing sessions can hurt the jaw joint
claims.believers: Users describe ear-area pressure, jaw popping and pain when eating after chewing.[3]
claims.experts: Temporomandibular literature lists gum chewing among suggested parafunctional habits, though evidence is described as lacking and the link debated.[2]

claims.believers: One user says masseter botulinum toxin was needed because the jaw became too big.[4]
claims.experts: Masseter hypertrophy is described as potentially changing facial shape and asymmetry.[1]

card.summary: Hard-gum chewing for hours to bulk the masseter; muscle growth is plausible, jaw pain is reported.
card.note: Users report jaw pain and clicking; overgrowth of the masseter is documented with constant gum chewing.

quick.overview:
People chew very hard Turkish gum such as Falim for many hours daily, aiming for a bigger, wider masseter and stronger-looking jaw.

The muscle can enlarge with constant gum chewing, but no trial has tested the practice for appearance. Users report both gains and pain.
quick.mechanism: Repetitive heavy chewing loads the masseter, which can hypertrophy with heavy use.
quick.risks: Reported effects include jaw pain, popping, ear-area pressure and excess masseter bulk. Temporomandibular literature lists gum chewing as a suggested but unproven contributor to jaw problems.
